name: Liste Appels Rattrapage
report_script:
date_debut = frappe.utils.add_months(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -3)
date_fin = frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -1)

data = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT
        t.name,
        t.custom_client,
        t.nom_client,
        t.tel,
        t.subject,
        t.custom_type_dintervention,
        t.status,
        t.raison_annulation,
        t.rapport_visite,
        t.starts_on,
        t.secteur,
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE('retard', LOWER(IFNULL(t.raison_annulation, ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('aqua',   LOWER(IFNULL(t.raison_annulation, ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('retard', LOWER(IFNULL(t.rapport_visite,    ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('aqua',   LOWER(IFNULL(t.rapport_visite,    ''))) > 0
            THEN 'Oui'
            ELSE 'Non'
        END AS autorisation_remise
    FROM `tabTache de travail` t
    WHERE
        DATE(t.starts_on) BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND t.custom_type_dintervention IN ('Entretien', 'Réparation')
        AND t.status IN ('Open', 'Cancelled')
        AND IFNULL(t.recontacte, '') = ''
        AND IFNULL(t.custom_client, '') != 'Aqua World'
    ORDER BY t.starts_on ASC
""", (date_debut, date_fin), as_dict=True)

for row in data:
    row['actions'] = ''

columns = [
    {"label": "Tâche",      "fieldname": "name",                     "fieldtype": "Link",       "options": "Tache de travail", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Client",     "fieldname": "custom_client",            "fieldtype": "Link",       "options": "Customer",         "width": 160},
    {"label": "Nom Client", "fieldname": "nom_client",               "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 150},
    {"label": "Téléphone",  "fieldname": "tel",                      "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 120},
    {"label": "Type",       "fieldname": "custom_type_dintervention","fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 100},
    {"label": "Statut",     "fieldname": "status",                   "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 80},
    {"label": "Raison",     "fieldname": "raison_annulation",        "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 160},
    {"label": "Rapport",    "fieldname": "rapport_visite",           "fieldtype": "Small Text", "width": 200},
    {"label": "Date",       "fieldname": "starts_on",                "fieldtype": "Datetime",   "width": 130},
    {"label": "Secteur",    "fieldname": "secteur",                  "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 90},
    {"label": "Remise",     "fieldname": "autorisation_remise",      "fieldtype": "Data",       "width": 80},
    {"label": "Actions",    "fieldname": "actions",                  "fieldtype": "HTML",       "width": 260},
]

data = columns, data, None, None, None
